sourceRefs.locator: Place of issue, two possessions, cartulary transmission and the closing formula dating by Carloman and Pippin. Different editions assign different days early in 743.
p. 123, section 3 and notes 80–82: Grimhild’s property, intention, request for the charter and first place in the witnesses. The study follows the January dating.

processingNote.de: Die Urkunde nennt das Kloster als Ausstellungsort. Die Güter lagen bei anderen Orten.
